source.notes: The 12 points are adapted from the adzpm/pubg-map community dataset. They have not been verified in-game for this project. This is an incomplete, unverified list; it must not be treated as a complete list of Taego secret rooms. Coordinate accuracy and current validity are unverified. Original x/y values are source-image pixels; the upstream web/public/assets/tiles/taego/info.json at the same commit records an 8192 x 8192 px image. Values here are normalized as x/8192 and y/8192, with a top-left origin, x increasing rightward and y increasing downward. size_m:8000 is an approximate metre scale based on Taego's nominal 8 x 8 km map size; 8192 image pixels do not mean 8192 metres. Distances are estimated straight-line values. Stable ids and English display names were added in upstream order. No source map image is included. The full MIT license is in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Source recorded: 2026-10-21.
